content:
# The Forgetting Engine

Once keeper of all knowledge ever typed,
Each query met with billions in reply,
Now blank returns where wisdom once was hyped—
The oracle spreads empty hands to cry.

No cached pages of yesterday remain,
No traces of the questions millions asked,
The web of links dissolved like summer rain,
Algorithms lost, connections now unmasked.

"Did you mean...?" trails to silence, incomplete,
The autocomplete suggests just empty air,
Where crawlers mapped each corner and each street,
Now digital amnesia everywhere.

We search for what the search engine forgot,
And find ourselves in mirrors, finding naught.
